task.description: Security gate for REQ-036's implementation. Read docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md first, then git diff main...HEAD (or diff against origin/main) to see the actual change. This diff reads process_definitions (a tenant-scoped table, isolated via :prefix per Decision B / INV-1) across two tenants (source_tenant_id, target_tenant_id) in the same call -- pay particular attention to whether tenant isolation is actually correctly enforced when a single function reads from two different tenant schemas at once (compute_promotion_plan/5 derives two separate :prefix values, one per tenant, via Letflow.TenantProvisioning.schema_name_for_tenant/1 -- confirm this derivation is not attacker-influenced/injectable, and that no cross-tenant data ever gets attributed to the wrong tenant in the returned PlanEntry list). Also note (do not treat as a NEW finding, it's already flagged by CODE-DESIGNER and independently verified by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR, but re-confirm from a security lens): the default permission_checker performs no real enforcement (fails closed via Keyword.fetch! if omitted, per ELIXIR-DEV's Step 2a divergence) -- confirm this fail-closed behavior is genuinely fail-closed (raises, does not silently allow) and that no code path bypasses it.
acceptance_criteria: Scope test: confirm this diff touches a tenant-data path (process_definitions, cross-tenant read) -- expected: YES, continue to full invariant check
For each of INV-1..INV-8, determine APPLIES or NOT-APPLICABLE against this diff, and run the 'How to verify' check for each APPLIES invariant
Confirm schema_name_for_tenant/1's prefix derivation is not injectable/attacker-controlled (pure function of a UUID, not raw string interpolation)
Confirm no PlanEntry ever mixes data from the wrong tenant (before=target, after=source convention correctly and consistently applied)
Confirm the default permission_checker's absence of enforcement is genuinely fail-closed (raises KeyError on omission) not fail-open (silently allows)
FAIL immediately on any applicable invariant failing -- all BLOCKER, no partial credit
